# Third-party assets

This prototype uses two interface sounds from Kenney's **New Platformer
Pack**. The pack is released under CC0 1.0; its original `License.txt` is kept
beside the imported files.

- **New Platformer Pack** — `sfx_select.ogg` and `sfx_magic.ogg`.
  Source: <https://www.kenney.nl/assets/new-platformer-pack>

Kenney credit is not required by the license, but is included here to make the
origin of every imported asset explicit.
